rules.name: DNS Zone Transfer Attempt
rules.description: Detects DNS zone transfer requests (AXFR) which may reveal internal network topology and host information
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND dns.query.type:AXFR AND NOT source.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 OR 172.16.0.0/12 OR 192.168.0.0/16)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Web Server Fingerprinting via HTTP Headers
rules.description: Detects responses revealing server technology details through HTTP headers like Server, X-Powered-By, or X-AspNet-Version
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.headers:* AND (http.response.headers.Server:* OR http.response.headers."X-Powered-By":* OR http.response.headers."X-AspNet-Version":*) AND NOT http.response.headers.Server:"*cloudflare*"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Directory Listing Exposure
rules.description: Detects web server directory listing responses that expose file and directory structures
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.status_code:200 AND http.response.body.content:(*"Directory listing"* OR *"Index of"* OR *"Parent Directory"*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Sensitive File Exposure via Web Server
rules.description: Detects access to sensitive files such as .git, .env, .htpasswd, web.config, or backup files through web requests
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.full:(*"/.git"* OR *"/.env"* OR *"/.htpasswd"* OR *"/web.config"* OR *"/wp-config.php"* OR *"/database.yml"* OR *"/config.php"* OR *"/.DS_Store"* OR *"/backup.sql"* OR *"/dump.sql"*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Comment Injection Metadata Leak
rules.description: Detects HTTP responses containing HTML comments that may leak internal paths, developer names, or internal URLs
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.body.content:*"<!--*"* AND NOT http.response.body.content:*"*analytics*"*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Error Page Information Disclosure
rules.description: Detects verbose error pages that reveal stack traces, database details, or internal paths
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.status_code:(400 OR 401 OR 403 OR 404 OR 500 OR 502 OR 503) AND http.response.body.content:(*"stack trace"* OR *"SQLException"* OR *"NullPointerException"* OR *"Traceback"* OR *"/usr/lib"* OR *"C:\\"* OR *"internal server error details"*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Robots.txt Sensitive Path Disclosure
rules.description: Detects access to robots.txt files that may reveal administrative or sensitive directory paths
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.path:"/robots.txt" AND http.response.status_code:200
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Web Application Sitemap Discovery
rules.description: Detects requests for sitemap.xml or other discovery files that may reveal application structure
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.path:("/sitemap.xml" OR "/sitemap_index.xml" OR "/.well-known/security.txt" OR "/.well-known/assetlinks.json")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Web Application Scanning Activity
rules.description: Detects high-volume requests characteristic of vulnerability scanners like Nikto, Nmap, or OWASP ZAP
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND (user_agent.original:(*"Nikto"* OR *"Nmap"* OR *"ZAP"* OR *"sqlmap"* OR *"dirbuster"* OR *"gobuster"* OR *"wfuzz"* OR *"BurpSuite"*)) OR (http.response.status_code:(404 OR 403) AND NOT source.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 OR 172.16.0.0/12 OR 192.168.0.0/16))
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Public Source Code Repository Exposure
rules.description: Detects references to internal source code repositories (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) exposed through web responses or metadata
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.body.content:(*"github.com/"* OR *"gitlab.com/"* OR *"bitbucket.org/"* OR *\.git/config*) AND NOT http.response.body.content:*"opensource"*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Search Engine Discovery of Sensitive Information
rules.description: Detects requests from search engine crawlers to sensitive endpoints that should not be indexed
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND user_agent.original:(*"Googlebot"* OR *"Bingbot"* OR *"Slurp"* OR *"DuckDuckBot"* OR *"Baiduspider"*) AND url.path:(*"/admin"* OR *"/api/internal"* OR *"/debug"* OR *"/console"*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Server Status Endpoint Exposure
rules.description: Detects access to server status endpoints such as /server-status, /server-info, or /phpinfo that reveal server configuration
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.path:("/server-status" OR "/server-info" OR "/phpinfo.php" OR "/phpinfo" OR "/.well-known/nodeinfo" OR "/actuator/env" OR "/actuator/configprops") AND http.response.status_code:200
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: API Documentation Exposure
rules.description: Detects unauthorized access to API documentation endpoints like Swagger, OpenAPI, or GraphQL introspection
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.path:(*"/swagger"* OR *"/api-docs"* OR *"/graphql"* OR *"/openapi.json"* OR *"/swagger-ui"* OR *"/redoc"*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Backup File Access Attempt
rules.description: Detects attempts to access backup files that may contain sensitive configuration or data
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.full:(*"/.bak"* OR *"/.old"* OR *"/.save"* OR *"/.copy"* OR *"/.orig"* OR *"/.swp"* OR *"/.tmp"* OR *"/~"* OR *"/.tar.gz"* OR *"/.zip"* OR *"/.sql"* OR *"/.dump"*) AND NOT source.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 OR 172.16.0.0/12 OR 192.168.0.0/16)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Cloud Metadata Service Access Attempt
rules.description: Detects attempts to access cloud metadata services (AWS, GCP, Azure) from web applications, indicating SSRF potential
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.full:(*"169.254.169.254"* OR *"/latest/meta-data"* OR *"metadata.google.internal"* OR *"/computeMetadata/v1"* OR *"169.254.169.254/latest"*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Network Service Enumeration via HTTP
rules.description: Detects enumeration of network services through HTTP requests to common service ports
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.status_code:(200 OR 301 OR 302 OR 401 OR 403) AND NOT source.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 OR 172.16.0.0/12 OR 192.168.0.0/16)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Web Application Technology Detection
rules.description: Detects technology fingerprinting requests targeting common framework indicators like /wp-login, /administrator, /phpmyadmin
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.path:(*"/wp-login"* OR *"/wp-admin"* OR *"/administrator"* OR *"/phpmyadmin"* OR *"/adminer"* OR *"/solr"* OR *"/kibana"* OR *"/grafana"* OR *"/jenkins"*) AND NOT source.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 OR 172.16.0.0/12 OR 192.168.0.0/16)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: HTTP Method Enumeration
rules.description: Detects use of uncommon HTTP methods (OPTIONS, TRACE, PUT, DELETE, PATCH) that may indicate enumeration attempts
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.request.method:(OPTIONS OR TRACE OR PUT OR DELETE OR PATCH) AND NOT source.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 OR 172.16.0.0/12 OR 192.168.0.0/16)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: SSL/TLS Weak Cipher Suite Usage
rules.description: Detects connections using weak or deprecated TLS cipher suites that may indicate downgrade attacks or misconfiguration
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND tls.cipher:(*"RC4"* OR *"DES"* OR *"3DES"* OR *"NULL"* OR *"EXPORT"* OR *"MD5"*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: TLS Certificate Anomaly or Expiration
rules.description: Detects expired, self-signed, or mismatched TLS certificates that may indicate interception or misconfiguration
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND (tls.server.not_after < now OR tls.server.issuer:*"self-signed"* OR (tls.server.subject:*"*"* AND NOT tls.server.subject:*"*.example.com"*))
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Default Credentials Usage Detected
rules.description: Detects login attempts using known default credentials for common applications and devices
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"login" AND (user.name:("admin" OR "root" OR "administrator" OR "test" OR "guest" OR "user" OR "demo" OR "operator") AND event.outcome:"success") AND NOT source.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 OR 172.16.0.0/12 OR 192.168.0.0/16)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Misconfigured HTTP Security Headers
rules.description: Detects web responses missing critical security headers like X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Content-Security-Policy, or HSTS
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.status_code:200 AND NOT http.response.headers:"X-Frame-Options" AND NOT http.response.headers:"Content-Security-Policy" AND NOT http.response.headers:"Strict-Transport-Security"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: CORS Misconfiguration - Wildcard Origin
rules.description: Detects Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) configurations that allow any origin, potentially enabling cross-site data theft
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.headers:"Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *" AND http.request.headers.Origin:*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Exposed Admin Interfaces
rules.description: Detects access to administrative interfaces from external or unauthorized IP ranges
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.path:(*"/admin"* OR *"/administrator"* OR *"/manager"* OR *"/console"* OR *"/dashboard"* OR *"/control"* OR *"/cpanel"* OR *"/phpmyadmin"* OR *"/wp-admin"*) AND NOT source.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 OR 172.16.0.0/12 OR 192.168.0.0/16)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Debug Mode Enabled in Production
rules.description: Detects indicators that application debug mode is enabled in production environments
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND (http.response.body.content:(*"DEBUG=True"* OR *"debug mode"* OR *"stack trace"* OR *"Django DEBUG"* OR *"Flask debug"* OR *"Rails development"*) OR url.query:*"debug=true"*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Insecure HTTP Methods Enabled
rules.description: Detects servers allowing potentially dangerous HTTP methods like PUT, DELETE, TRACE, or CONNECT
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.request.method:(PUT OR DELETE OR TRACE OR CONNECT) AND http.response.status_code:(200 OR 201 OR 204) AND NOT source.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 OR 172.16.0.0/12 OR 192.168.0.0/16)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Outdated Software Version Detected
rules.description: Detects HTTP responses revealing outdated or vulnerable software versions via Server headers or error pages
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.headers.Server:(*"Apache/2.2"* OR *"Apache/2.0"* OR *"nginx/1.0"* OR *"PHP/5"* OR *"OpenSSL/1.0"* OR *"IIS/6"* OR *"IIS/7"*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Clickjacking - Missing X-Frame-Options
rules.description: Detects responses missing X-Frame-Options or Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors headers, enabling clickjacking attacks
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.status_code:200 AND NOT http.response.headers:"X-Frame-Options" AND NOT http.response.headers:"Content-Security-Policy:*frame-ancestors*"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Content-Type Sniffing Vulnerability
rules.description: Detects responses missing X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header, allowing browsers to MIME-sniff content types
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.status_code:200 AND NOT http.response.headers:"X-Content-Type-Options"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Subresource Integrity Missing on External Scripts
rules.description: Detects web pages loading external scripts without Subresource Integrity (SRI) hashes
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.body.content:*"<script src="http"* AND NOT http.response.body.content:*"integrity="*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Cookie Without Secure Flag
rules.description: Detects session cookies set without the Secure flag, allowing transmission over unencrypted HTTP
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.headers:"Set-Cookie" AND NOT http.response.headers:"Set-Cookie*Secure*"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Cookie Without HttpOnly Flag
rules.description: Detects session cookies set without the HttpOnly flag, allowing JavaScript access to cookie values
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.headers:"Set-Cookie" AND NOT http.response.headers:"Set-Cookie*HttpOnly*"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: CSP Header Missing or Misconfigured
rules.description: Detects responses missing Content-Security-Policy header or with overly permissive CSP directives like default-src * or unsafe-eval
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.status_code:200 AND (NOT http.response.headers:"Content-Security-Policy" OR http.response.headers:"Content-Security-Policy: *default-src *'unsafe-eval'*" OR http.response.headers:"Content-Security-Policy: *default-src **")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: HSTS Header Missing
rules.description: Detects HTTPS responses missing the Strict-Transport-Security header, enabling SSL stripping attacks
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.scheme:"https" AND http.response.status_code:200 AND NOT http.response.headers:"Strict-Transport-Security"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Information Disclosure via Server Headers
rules.description: Detects HTTP responses that leak internal IP addresses, server versions, or technology stack through headers
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND (http.response.headers."X-Forwarded-For":* OR http.response.headers."X-Real-IP":* OR http.response.headers."X-Internal-IP":* OR http.response.headers."X-AspNet-Version":* OR http.response.headers."X-Runtime":*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Database Error Messages Exposed to Users
rules.description: Detects HTTP responses containing database error messages that reveal schema or connection details
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.body.content:(*"SQLSTATE"* OR *"mysql_fetch"* OR *"ORA-0"* OR *"PostgreSQL.*ERROR"* OR *"sqlite_"* OR *"Microsoft OLE DB"* OR *"ODBC SQL Server Driver"* OR *"SQLSyntaxErrorException"* OR *"pg_query"* OR *"psycopg2"* OR *"Unclosed quotation mark"*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Exposed .git Directory
rules.description: Detects access to .git directory contents that may expose source code and repository information
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.path:(*"/.git/config"* OR *"/.git/HEAD"* OR *"/.gitignore"* OR *"/.git/"*) AND http.response.status_code:200
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Environment File Exposure
rules.description: Detects access to .env files containing database credentials, API keys, or other secrets
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.path:("/.env" OR "/.env.local" OR "/.env.production" OR "/.env.staging" OR "/.env.development") AND http.response.status_code:200
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Misconfigured Cross-Origin Resource Sharing for Credentials
rules.description: Detects CORS configurations that allow credential transmission from any origin, enabling authenticated cross-origin data theft
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.headers:"Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true" AND http.response.headers:"Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: XML External Entity Processing Enabled
rules.description: Detects potential XXE attack patterns in XML requests including DOCTYPE declarations with SYSTEM or PUBLIC identifiers
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.request.body.content:(*"<!DOCTYPE"* AND *"SYSTEM"*) OR (http.request.body.content:(*"<!ENTITY"* AND *"SYSTEM"*) OR http.request.body.content:*"<!DOCTYPE"* AND *"PUBLIC"*))
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: User Enumeration via Login Error Messages
rules.description: Detects authentication responses that reveal whether a username exists, enabling user enumeration attacks
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"login" AND event.outcome:"failure" AND message:(*"user not found"* OR *"username does not exist"* OR *"no account with that email"* OR *"invalid username"*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Excessive Failed Login Attempts
rules.description: Detects brute force login attempts exceeding threshold from a single source IP
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"login" AND event.outcome:"failure"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Account Lockout Mechanism Failure
rules.description: Detects continued login attempts after account should have been locked, indicating lockout mechanism failure
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"login" AND event.outcome:"failure" AND user.name:*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Privilege Escalation Attempt - Role Change
rules.description: Detects unauthorized attempts to change user roles or privilege levels through API calls or direct manipulation
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:("role-change" OR "privilege-change" OR "role-assign" OR "group-add") AND event.outcome:"success" AND NOT source.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 OR 172.16.0.0/12 OR 192.168.0.0/16)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Inactive Account Activation Attempt
rules.description: Detects login attempts against disabled, suspended, or inactive accounts
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"login" AND event.outcome:"failure" AND event.reason:(*"disabled"* OR *"suspended"* OR *"inactive"* OR *"locked"* OR *"deactivated"*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Identity Provider Misconfiguration - SAML Assertion
rules.description: Detects SAML assertion issues including missing signatures, expired assertions, or replayed assertion IDs
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"saml-auth" AND (NOT event.data.signature:* OR event.data.expired:*true* OR message:*"SAML assertion replayed"* OR message:*"SAML signature invalid"*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: OAuth Token Abuse - Missing Scope Validation
rules.description: Detects OAuth token usage where the scope exceeds what was originally granted
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"oauth-token-validate" AND (NOT event.data.scope:* OR event.data.scope_granted < event.data.scope_requested)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Account Provisioning Without Approval
rules.description: Detects user account creation events that bypass normal approval workflows
rules.query: event.category:"iam" AND event.action:"user-create" AND NOT event.data.approval_id:*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Identity Data Exposure in API Response
rules.description: Detects API responses containing PII fields like SSN, national ID, or date of birth without proper masking
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.body.content:(*"ssn":"*"* OR *"social_security":"*"* OR *"date_of_birth":"*"* OR *"passport_number":"*"* OR *"national_id":"*") AND NOT http.response.body.content:*"***"*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Directory Service Enumeration via LDAP
rules.description: Detects LDAP queries that enumerate user accounts, groups, or organizational structure
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND (ldap.query:* OR url.path:*"/ldap"*) AND ldap.query:(*"(objectClass=user)"* OR *"(objectClass=group)"* OR *"(objectClass=organizationalUnit)"* OR *"(objectClass=person)"*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Mass Account Creation from Single IP
rules.description: Detects automated mass account creation attempts from a single source IP, indicating bot activity or abuse
rules.query: event.category:"iam" AND event.action:"user-create" AND event.outcome:"success"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Role-Based Access Control Bypass Attempt
rules.description: Detects attempts to access resources or perform actions outside the user's assigned role
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"access" AND event.outcome:"denied" AND (url.path:(*"/admin"* OR *"/manage"* OR *"/superuser"* OR *"/configure"*) OR event.action:("delete" OR "admin-action" OR "role-assign"))
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Multi-Factor Authentication Bypass Attempt
rules.description: Detects attempts to bypass MFA including skipped steps, replayed tokens, or downgraded authentication
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND (event.action:"mfa-bypass" OR event.action:"mfa-skip" OR (event.action:"login" AND event.outcome:"success" AND NOT event.data.mfa_verified:*true*) AND user.name:*admin*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Identity Provider Token Replay Attack
rules.description: Detects reuse of authentication tokens across multiple sessions or from different IPs, indicating token theft
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "process") AND (message:*"wstg"* OR url.path:*"wstg"* OR process.command_line:*"wstg"*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Password Policy Violation
rules.description: Detects password changes that do not meet complexity requirements, indicating weak password policy enforcement
rules.query: event.category:"iam" AND event.action:"password-change" AND event.outcome:"success" AND NOT event.data.password_length:>12 AND NOT event.data.password_complexity:*true*
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Credential Stuffing Attack Pattern
rules.description: Detects patterns consistent with credential stuffing attacks: multiple login failures across many accounts from same IP
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"login" AND event.outcome:"failure"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: PII Data Exposure in Identity Provider Response
rules.description: Detects identity provider responses containing unmasked PII fields such as social security numbers or national identifiers
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND (event.data.ssn:* OR event.data.national_id:* OR event.data.passport:* OR event.data.tax_id:*) AND NOT event.data.ssn:(*"***"* OR *"XXX"*)
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Cross-Tenant Identity Data Access
rules.description: Detects attempts to access identity data belonging to another tenant in a multi-tenant environment
rules.query: event.category:"iam" AND event.action:"access" AND event.outcome:"denied" AND event.data.tenant_id:* AND NOT event.data.user_tenant_id == event.data.resource_tenant_id
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Identity Store Synchronization Anomaly
rules.description: Detects anomalous volumes of identity store synchronization events that may indicate data exfiltration or poisoning
rules.query: event.category:"iam" AND event.action:("sync" OR "provision" OR "deprovision") AND event.outcome:"success"
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: SSO Session Token Theft via Referer Header
rules.description: Detects SSO session tokens leaking through Referer headers on external links
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.request.headers.Referer:* AND (http.request.headers.Referer:*"token="* OR http.request.headers.Referer:*"access_token="* OR http.request.headers.Referer:*"session_id="*) AND NOT url.domain:*internal*
author: SIEM Alert Rules
